proof_body:
by
  intro a
  refine ⟨Real.arctan a, ⟨Real.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arctan a, Real.arctan_lt_pi_div_two a, Real.tan_arctan a⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro y ⟨hy1, hy2, hy3⟩
  apply Real.strictMonoOn_tan.injOn ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ ⟨Real.neg_pi_div_two_lt_arctan a, Real.arctan_lt_pi_div_two a⟩
  rw [hy3, Real.tan_arctan a]
target_source: ∀ a : ℝ, ∃! x : ℝ, -(Real.pi / 2) < x ∧ x < Real.pi / 2 ∧ Real.tan x = a
